messages:
Maya P: kicking off deploy window for v1.12.3 — rolling to 10% now, observability team please keep an eye on SLO dashboards :eyes:
Alex B: noted. I'll watch p95 and 5xx on the gateway. setting a dashboard snapshot in 5m.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=v1.12.3 roll=prod targets=10% initiator=@Maya P
Sam K: quick heads-up — can we pin embed-model route to v1.11 for now until we confirm latency on quantized path?
Maya P: good call. plan: roll majority, but pin embeds route for critical customers. Sam, can you push the pin?
Sam K: on it. running:
```
# pin route for embeds
./deploy pin --route=embeds --version=v1.11 --scope=customer:critical
```
Sam K: done. deploy-bot: Route pin update applied for embeds -> v1.11 (scope=customer:critical)
Linh T: seeing a small p95 bump on kvcache read ops in eu-west (0.9s -> 1.4s) since the first batch. not sure if it's noise or warming.
Alex B: can you post a screenshot of the chart? also check error budget burn rate for the last 5m.
Linh T: attaching snapshot: https://redwood-obsv/company/dashboards/slo/p95?kvcache&euwest (posted)
ops-runbook-bot: ALERT (info): kv-cache p95 increased to 1.38s in eu-west, error budget burn rate 12% over last 5m. recommended actions: monitor for 10m, consider halting if sustained >15%
Maya P: thanks. let's hold the ramp for another 5m. put a temporary traffic cap at 20% until we confirm. deploy-bot, cap traffic.
deploy-bot: Command received: cap traffic to 20% for release=v1.12.3
deploy-bot: Traffic cap applied (now 20%)
Sam K: also noticing a handful of 502s on embed-service trace group correlated with the higher latency window. small sample (12 requests).
Alex B: 502s + p95 bump = probably kv-cache cold starts on quantized kernels. Sam, can you revert kernel flags for embed-service if the trend continues?
Sam K: will prepare a quick rollback command, but preferring pin first.
Linh T: running a fast GC on kvcache nodes in eu-west to reduce spikes. kicking it now.
Maya P: ops-runbook-bot — mark this deploy status as "degraded" and add a note to release notes draft.
ops-runbook-bot: Deploy status updated: degraded. Note appended to release notes draft: "Monitoring observed transient kv-cache p95 increase; embeds route pinned for critical customers; traffic ramp temporarily capped at 20%."
Alex B: after the GC the p95 dropped back to ~0.95s — still above baseline but within acceptable SLO delta. error budget burn back down to 5% (5m).
Maya P: good. keep cap and watch for 10m. if stable, we'll resume ramp to 50%.
Sam K: quick housekeeping — adding a short note to the changelog so support knows about the embeds pin.
Sam K: /note add "Embeds route pinned to v1.11 for critical customers due to kv-cache warming; full rollout resumes once p95 stabilizes."
Maya P: team, if p95 holds <1.1s for next 10m, I'll ask deploy-bot to resume to 50%. otherwise we'll rollback the new quantized embed build. agree?
Alex B: agree.
Linh T: agree. continuing to tail logs for any 5xx uptick.
ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: if 5xx > 0.5% sustained or p95 > 1.5s for 15m, escalate to incident channel and initiate rollback checklist.
Maya P: noted. thanks everyone. updating the release notes link with the current note: https://confluence.redwood/release-notes/v1.12.3
Sam K: FYI, if we end up rolling back, we should record customer-impact matrix for the postmortem — quick pointer: affected routes embeds (partial), chat (low), api (none).
Maya P: copied. standing by.
Alex B: 10m check-in scheduled in 8m. I'll post a follow-up snapshot before that. :calendar:
Maya P: thanks.
deploy-bot: Next scheduled checkpoint at +10m. Current rollout: 20% capped.
Linh T: 5m mark update — p95 steady ~1.02s, 502s dropped to 2 occurrences in sample. no new error groups.
Maya P: that's promising. let's keep monitoring. if the 10m snapshot looks stable, resume. otherwise, prepare rollback plan.
Maya P: update for support + docs: "Hold on full embed quantized rollout; pin applied for critical customers; monitoring team is observing recovery."
Sam K: noted and added to internal status page.
Alex B: posting final pre-ramp snapshot now.
Alex B: snapshot: https://redwood-obsv/company/dashboards/slo/p95/snapshot/1724242500
Maya P: okay team — thanks for rapid responses. will call resume at the +10m if stable.
ops-runbook-bot: Checkpoint passed: no escalation conditions met. Continue monitoring.
